label: Ikony · Robot
desc: Trhavé pohyby po segmentech, paže po kloubech nahoru, otočka trupu, vypnutí a zapnutí.
desc_en: Jerky segmented moves, the arm rising joint by joint, the torso rotating, a power-down and a power-up.
style_tail: , static camera, cinematic studio lighting, photorealistic, one continuous dance movement at a steady moderate tempo, highly detailed
negative: blurry, low quality, watermark, text, distorted face, extra fingers, bad anatomy, extra limbs

beats.prompt: the dancer stands perfectly rigid and turns the head in small jerky steps toward the camera, then stops
one arm lifts in jerky segments, first the shoulder, then the elbow, then the wrist, until the hand is level with the head, and locks there
the torso rotates in jerky steps to one side while the raised arm stays locked in place, and stops
the dancer powers down: the head drops forward and the arms fall loose as the body slumps, and stays slumped
the dancer powers back up in jerky steps, head lifting last, and locks into a rigid stare at the camera
